changes: Reworded purpose to say what it means (copied for the benefit of all beings). The substance is unchanged.

purpose: sarvasattvārthahetunā (copied for the benefit of all beings)
notes: The colophon gives two dates. 'samvat 781' names no era. It is most likely NS 781 (c. 1661 CE) and was probably carried over from the exemplar, which fits a Devanāgarī copy that is much later. 'samvat 1951 sāla māghavadi 9' is taken as VS 1951. Māgha kṛṣṇa 9 of VS 1951 falls in January/February 1895 CE, and this is treated as the date of copying. The colophon names no human persons.
